assets.name: vessel
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: original conceptual hero image for the ATOMA technical, clinical, mysterious matcha storefront; not verified real packaging or equipment.
Primary request: Create one landscape image, 1536 x 1024, a clean cinematic photorealistic high-end CGI product render.
Scene/backdrop: Seamless near-black void, with a very faint floor reflection far below the floating object, no pedestal.
Subject: A precise low cylindrical brushed stainless-steel specimen vessel, open top holding a softly sculpted small mound of extremely fine vivid green matcha powder. A thin machined circular metal lid floats a short distance above the vessel on the same vertical axis, revealing the powder. The vessel and lid are both floating, isolated.
Composition/framing: Camera front three-quarter view slightly above the vessel mouth. Object centered, using the middle approximately 50 percent of image width and 70 percent of image height, deep black negative space on all sides especially left and right. Entire vessel and lid fully contained with generous padding for responsive hero crops.
Lighting/mood: Hard white rim lights and a soft cool overhead strip reveal precise machined brushed metal edges and subtle black gradients. Clinical, impersonal, alien calm. Premium production-engineering visual language.
Color palette: Restrained near-black and silver with actual vivid matcha green as the only organic or color presence.
Materials/textures: Realistic fine brushed stainless steel, razor precise machined edges, velvety fine powder texture, faint dust only very close to the powder.
Constraints: Product first. One vessel, one floating lid, matcha powder. No humans, fields, heritage imagery, room scenery, labels, typography, logos, branding, text, fake measurement numbers, tubes, needles, watermarks, warm or beige background. No textual UI rendered.

assets.name: powder-macro
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: original conceptual macro material study for ATOMA matcha storefront inspection mode.
Primary request: Create one 1536 x 1024 landscape image: fine vivid dark green matcha powder sculpted into a low ridgeline and a smooth channel, tightly framed as a beautiful material under controlled laboratory visual study.
Scene/backdrop: Black background fading at all edges, with deep dark recesses.
Composition/framing: Distinct extreme macro material closeup. Rich matcha green across the middle of the landscape image. Powder ridgeline and smooth channel occupy the central image and dissolve naturally into near-black around the perimeter.
Style/medium: Cinematic photorealistic high-end macro photography / premium CGI material study, precise and tactile.
Lighting/mood: Raking cool side light revealing extremely fine dust texture and bright pinpoint powder edges. Restrained, technical, clinical, impersonal, mysterious calm.
Color palette: Rich dark vivid matcha green with near-black. Matcha is the only organic/color presence.
Materials/textures: Extremely fine velvety powder, tactile microscopic particulate detail, softly sculpted low ridgeline, smooth channel, dark recesses.
Constraints: No vessels, packaging, plants, humans, fields, heritage imagery, typography, text, UI, labels, branding, props, tubes, needles, logos, watermarks, warm or beige background. This is an original conceptual material study.
